title: Reporting is for reviewers
changes: The issue reporter is now off by default. Reviewers switch it on by opening any page with ?report=1; it then stays on for that browser until ?report=0 or the panel's own switch turns it off.
The flag is taken out of the address bar once it has been read, so it does not travel into links copied from the site afterwards.
docs/REVIEWING.md explains the whole thing for whoever is doing the reviewing.
